## Description and Rationale

I am currently a PhD student at the Faculty of Transport and Traffic Engineering, University of Belgrade. My academic journey is fueled by a deep passion for machine learning and its power to solve complex, real-world problems.For me, data science is more than just a field of study—it is what I truly love to do. This competition is another incredible opportunity for me to dive into a new data challenge, apply my skills, and do what I am most passionate about.I look forward to pushing the boundaries of data with you all!
